message.content:
Artificial flower petals of polyester fabric fall under heading 6702, which covers artificial flowers, foliage, fruit, and parts thereof. Subheading 6702.90 covers "other" materials, and 6702.90.65 covers other artificial flowers, foliage, and fruit and parts thereof, of man-made fibers.

The subheadings run as follows:
- 6702.10: plastics
- 6702.90.10: of feathers
- 6702.90.20: of human hair
- 6702.90.35: of paper
- 6702.90.65: of man-made fibers or other textile materials, other
- 6702.90.70: other

Within 6702.90.65, the statistical suffix is 00 for "other," giving 6702.90.6500. The earlier 6702.90.35 line actually reads "of textile materials, other than man-made fibers", hence the 6702.90.65 placement for man-made fibers. I am fairly confident in 6702.90.65.
